reasoning: The icon clearly depicts an upright battery filled to roughly two-thirds capacity. While it originates as a UI status indicator for charge level, in a task list it serves well as a concrete icon for tasks about batteries, charging devices, power banks, and replacing household cells, though it is nearly interchangeable with other battery-level glyphs.
